select_where_you_will_launch_this_game_t: Select where you will launch this game. The identifier and profile stay the same across launchers.
game_properties_general_launch_options_u: Game properties → General → Launch options. Use the line below and keep Proton selection in Steam.
game_settings_advanced_wrapper_command_e: Game settings → Advanced → Wrapper command. Enter the executable and arguments in their respective fields.
configure_game_system_options_command_pr: Configure game → System options → Command prefix. Use the line below.
use_the_launcher_s_wrapper_or_command_pr: Use the launcher's wrapper or command prefix setting. It must pass the complete game command to PeliRun; a game-arguments-only field is insufficient.
set_up_once_then_save_changes_in_peligam: Set up once. Then save changes in PeliGames and relaunch the game. This does not automatically change the other launcher's selected Proton.
flatpak_the_launcher_needs_access_to_pel: Flatpak: the launcher needs access to PeliRun, its profile, and the game's components. No permissions are changed automatically.
use_this_profile_in_another_launcher_set: Use this profile in another launcher. Settings saved here apply on the next game launch.
could_not_prepare_the_profile_try_again: Could not prepare the profile. Try again.
